name: HyperNeRF
definition: An extension of neural radiance fields into higher dimensions to allow topological variations. The template NeRF is embedded in a higher-dimensional space $(x, w) \in \mathbb{R}^{3+W}$, where a slice taken by an intersecting high-dimensional slicing surface yields a full 3D NeRF.
summary: HyperNeRF models non-rigidly deforming scenes with topological variations by extending NeRF's 3D input space with higher-dimensional ambient coordinates.
